Doctor FishUNIT 14 · SCIENCE · HOMEWORKS 1–3
FILE 14/A HOMEWORK 1 · VOCABULARY & COMPREHENSION

The Spa Intake File 🐟

You work at a hot-spring spa in Turkey. Before your first shift you must learn the treatment vocabulary and understand exactly what the doctor fish do — and do not do. Complete all five sections of the intake file. 30 points. Estimated time: 35–45 minutes.

8 WORD MEANINGS8 GAP FILLS5 COMPREHENSION5 TRUE / FALSE4 ADVERBS
PROGRESS · 0 / 30 answered
📖 Reading passage — Doctor Fish (218 words) · tap to open

For a long time, people have known that eating fish is healthy. It is common knowledge that eating fish is good for our skin. Now people are noticing that living fish, in particular "doctor fish," can also be good for our skin. Going to a "doctor fish" hot spring is becoming a popular way to treat certain forms of skin disease.

"Doctor fish" are an interesting species of fish called garra rufa. They are found near two small towns in Turkey. In these towns, there are hot springs. These little fish live in the warm waters of these hot springs. Because it is hard for nutrients to survive in hot spring water, the fish are very hungry. As a result, they like to eat dead skin.

Every year, about 3,000 visitors come to these towns to sit in the hot springs with the fish. As they sit, the fish surround them and eat the bad parts of their skin. Amazingly, the fish do not harm the healthy skin. According to studies, "doctor fish" can help people with severe skin problems get clear skin in 21 days. Unfortunately, this is not a permanent cure. But luckily, the results can last for many months.

For people suffering from certain skin diseases, "doctor fish" may be a good option for treatment.
